feature_contract.goal: Keep the original 4:3 main menu at correct widescreen and portrait aspect in both XR eyes without letting plugin-generated black letterbox rails inherit a world draw or consume the original game's HUD/effect source.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only plugin source-backbuffer native menu letterbox GPU Draw ownership and its checked side/top-bottom geometry. Exclude F11 ImGui submission, gameplay HUD, GOAL, SkyGlow, lens flare and original game sprites.
trace_stages: Original 4:3 native front-end and car-selection sprites are rasterized by the game before the plugin EndScene callback.
BuildMenuBarGeometry selects identical source-backbuffer side or top-bottom rails; hooks_overlay.cpp submits two direct D3D9 TRIANGLESTRIP primitives.
ScopedExternalOverlaySemantic brackets only those two R84 DrawPrimitive hook submissions as ScreenOverlay2D for stereo screen-space projection, then restores original game/F11 semantic state.
subcomponents: Give both plugin-owned source-rect rails one scoped external two-eye route rather than letting them borrow the prior world cached WVP.
Preserve desktop/mono native behavior, the aspect/reset geometry, original one-shot GPU owner tokens, and normal game/F11 source isolation.

diagnosis.original_evidence: Observed native hook D3DEndScene generates two independent 4:3 rail DrawPrimitive calls without any game or external overlay scope; GPU R84 dispatch bases stereo route on capture of current semantic.
source_trace: src/vr/ui/menu_letterbox_geometry.hpp generates side/top-bottom geometry from original source dimensions.
src/overlay/hooks_overlay.cpp submits plugin-owned primitives after the original scene and before optional ImGui.
src/vr/game/render_semantics.hpp ScopedExternalOverlaySemantic preserves pending game tokens; R84 R30/R33 accepts explicit ScreenOverlay2D semantics.
diagnosis.root_cause: The two plugin-generated black-bar primitives previously lacked an explicit external ScreenOverlay2D owner at the physical D3D9 Draw boundary, so R84 could evaluate stale game/world semantic context rather than treating them as a single stereo screen overlay.
alternatives_rejected: Do not modify original game EXE or globally tag ScreenHud/SkyGlow/world draws; do not change menu geometry/aspect maths which are independently guarded.
Static ownership and CI do not prove visible HMD menu correctness.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: The two existing TRIANGLESTRIP submissions now execute under one RAII ScopedExternalOverlaySemantic; negative source verifier rejects lost scope, wrong owner or missing second GPU submission.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: tools/verify_vr_menu_letterbox_aspect.py checks both draws and three destructive negative mutations, in addition to 4:3/16:9/21:9/portrait geometry and reset coverage.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: Only an external screen overlay can be selected for the native bar Draw and mirrored into two R84 eyes; native or non-stereo fallback remains unchanged.
diagnosis.evidence_limit: Static source path and targeted CI only; no matching Quest3/VDXR physical optical verification.
